tvl_methodology_warning: DefiLlama's $16.3M TVL figure conflates four asset classes that custody differently. Of $16.3M reported, only ~$2.5M sits inside Equilibria-deployed contracts directly (Pendle LP + PT positions in reward pools). The dominant ~$13.8M is PENDLE locked inside Pendle Finance's vePENDLE contract on Equilibria's collective behalf — custody risk is Pendle's. The remaining $2.3M (DL `*-staking` buckets) is ePENDLE staked under Equilibria. The v1 brief's $102.6M headline is wrong: actual DL TVL on its claimed snapshot date 2026-04-29 was $13.04M, not $102.6M.

tvl_decomposition.note: DL `tvl[-1]` total = $16,320,222. Top tokensInUsd: PENDLE $13.83M + PENDLE-LPT $1.25M + PLP-* tokens ~$1.24M (sum). DL `*-staking` buckets total $2.30M. Audit-evaluable = LP + PT/PLP + staking = ~$4.79M (inside Equilibria-deployed contracts). The PENDLE-locked $13.83M is custodied by Pendle's vePENDLE contract `0x4f30A9D41B80ecC5B94306AB4364951AE3170210`, NOT Equilibria's contracts. Equilibria's pendleProxy controls vePENDLE voting/reward rights via `vePENDLE.balanceOf(pendleProxy) = 7,352,752 vePENDLE` (~11% of all-Pendle locked PENDLE).
